summary: Define autonomous Subactor agent integration standard

delivery.outcome: A reusable Wellmanifest Autonomy standard that lets adopted projects continue routine development through governed Subactor agents and Semcod tools without per-PR human approval.
nonGoals: Host or implement an agent runtime, queue, GitHub App, LLM, or repository mirror
Allow implementers to validate or approve their own changes
Grant autonomous authority over secrets, destructive infrastructure, billing, legal, identity, or security-critical effects
Permit a standing grant to renew, widen, or disable itself
Merge this standard without independent current-head approval

architecture.decision: Standardize a repository-bound standing autonomy grant, strict separation of agent duties, bounded continuation lifecycle, and protected exact-head publication boundary; keep execution in adopting Subactor and Semcod runtimes.
interfaceChanges: Introduce wellmanifest.autonomy/manifest/v1 as a pre-stable public policy contract
Introduce wellmanifest.autonomy/profile/v1 for versioned runtime capability mappings
Define standing-grant and exact-head automated publication semantics
dataChanges: Define immutable repository, grant, profile, task, pull-request, and receipt bindings
Define risk, change, time, retry, cost, concurrency, and continuation budgets
architecture.rollback: Remove ticket-owned implementation paths; preserve the governed baseline and ticket evidence.
